info.title: ferrobot daemon API
info.description: Operator API of `ferrobotd` (version 1, all paths under `/v1`). Served on the loopback UI listener (default `127.0.0.1:7878`). Every endpoint except `GET /v1/health` needs the operator token as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`; `GET` requests (the WebSocket, avatar images) may pass `?access_token=<token>` instead. The daemon generates the token on first start in `<data dir>/api-token` (mode 0600) unless `--api-token` / `FERROBOT_API_TOKEN` sets one. Live updates: `GET /v1/ws` streams `UiEvent` frames, see `ui-events.schema.json`. Incoming webhooks (`POST /hooks/{id}/{secret}`) share the listener outside `/v1`: the secret in their path is their only key, the operator token is not accepted there. The separate agent listener (runner WebSocket and MCP, bearer-token auth) is not part of this document; its frames are described in `runner-protocol.schema.json`.

get.summary: A HTML block by signed, expiring link, as a sandboxed page.

parameters.name: exp
parameters.description: Expiry of the link (unix seconds), from `url`.

404.description: Unknown block, or the link expired

get.summary:
A shared file by signed, expiring link (HMAC over agent, file and expiry), as frames cannot
send the operator token. Pages open sandboxed, a real PDF inline, anything else downloads.

parameters.name: exp
parameters.description: Expiry of the link (unix seconds), from `url`.

parameters.name: download
parameters.description: Any value: send the file as a download.

post.summary:
Takes a POST from another service (JSON or text) and queues it for the webhook's agent.
Authorized only by the secret in the path; the operator token is not accepted.

parameters.name: secret
parameters.description: The webhook's secret, from its URL

requestBody.description: JSON or text, at most 64 KiB

get.summary: Lists all agents.

post.summary: Registers an agent and provisions its sandbox.

409.description: Name already taken, or the agent limit (`FERROBOT_MAX_AGENTS`) is reached

get.summary: Deleted agents' last names, for mentions of them in old messages.
Fetches one agent.

delete.summary: Deletes an agent with its sandbox, disk and snapshots (unless `keep_data`).

parameters.name: keep_data
parameters.description:
Keep the agent's persistent disk (home volume) and snapshot images.
By default they are deleted with the agent.

get.summary: The agent's avatar image.

put.summary: Uploads (replaces) the avatar. Body: the raw image.

requestBody.description: PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF, at most 512 KiB

delete.summary: Removes the avatar (clients fall back to the character avatar).

post.summary:
Compacts the agent's conversation: its model keeps a summary instead of the whole history,
so its context shrinks. Claude Code agents only (their own `/compact`, run by the daemon).

409.description: Nothing to compact yet, or the agent is in a turn

get.summary: Ids of the connectors the agent may use.

put.summary: Replaces the connectors the agent may use. Takes effect on its next turn.

get.summary: How full the agent's context is.

Turn events (incoming messages, text, tool calls and results, lifecycle),
oldest first, up to 500 per call; page with `after`.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: Return events with an id greater than this (default 0).

post.summary:
Reacts to one of the agent's messages (an `assistant_text` event) with one emoji. The agent
hears of it in a short `[ferrobot]` note from the operator, which starts a turn; the chat shows
the emoji on its message (a `user_reaction` event naming the note as `note_id`), not the note.

204.description: Recorded, and the agent was told

post.summary:
Runs a command in the agent's computer (operator only, loopback API).
Wakes the computer if it sleeps.

get.summary: A file the agent shared (`file` event id), from storage.

post.summary:
Aborts the agent's running turn, if any; with `chain`, the work it set off as well (Stop).
Interrupted messages are not retried.

parameters.name: chain
parameters.description:
Also stop every agent working on a message from this one (and from those, and so on), and
drop the agent messages queued to or from any of them.

get.summary: Lists or searches the agent's memories.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Full-text search; empty lists the most recently updated entries.

post.summary: Creates or replaces a memory.

get.summary:
The agent's conversation: messages to and from it, oldest first (last 200). Call room turns
(`room_id` set) are left out; they are in the room.

post.summary:
Sends a message from the operator (`user`) to an agent's mailbox. Wakes
the agent if it sleeps.

Starts a new chat: the agent's next turn begins a fresh model session without the earlier
messages. The chat history stays visible.

204.description: The agent's next turn starts fresh

post.summary:
Answers a question card: the agent gets the answers as one user message and the card locks.
An approval card's decision goes to the waiting tool call instead (`409` once it timed out).

400.description: Answers do not fit the card

post.summary: Marks the agent's chat as read (resets `unread`).

Clears the agent's credential or tools problem so its waiting messages run; if it still
stands, the next model call sets it again.

get.summary: The agent's routines, by name.

post.summary: Creates a routine.

400.description: Invalid schedule, time zone or texts

409.description: Name already used by this agent

get.summary: Live sandbox status for the info panel.

delete.summary: Removes the sandbox but keeps the agent and its disk; `wake` recreates it.

get.summary: Snapshots of the agent's sandbox, newest first.

post.summary: Snapshots the sandbox (Docker: root filesystem + home directory).

delete.summary: Deletes a snapshot and its data.

post.summary:
Replaces the sandbox with one booted from the snapshot. The current
disk state is discarded; the agent's chat and memory are kept.

Puts the agent to sleep, keeping its disk. A new message or `wake`
starts (or resumes) it again.

parameters.name: level
parameters.description:
`cold` (default) stops, `warm` pauses, `archived` moves the sandbox to object storage.
Backends without pause or archive answer 501; Firecracker stops instead of archiving.

501.description: The backend cannot pause or archive

get.summary:
One of the agent's turns as a timeline: its model calls and tool calls with their times, the
cards it waited on and the messages it handed to other agents.

parameters.name: turn_id
parameters.description: Turn id, as on the turn's events

post.summary:
Puts a file from the operator into the agent's workspace folder `uploads/`, waking its
computer if it sleeps. Body: the raw file, at most 25 MiB.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description:
The file's name. Only letters, digits, `.`, `-` and `_` are kept (others become `_`);
a name already in `uploads/` gets `-2`, `-3`, ... before its extension.

post.summary: Starts (or re-creates) the agent's sandbox.

get.summary: Who is in the operator's voice call.

put.summary:
Starts, changes or (with no agents) ends the voice call. Agents in it can invite others
with their `invite_to_call` tool. With two or more agents the call moves into a room.

post.summary:
Sends the operator's message to the call with the call instructions. Without a room every
agent gets it as a turn. In a room it is a line, and the agents take it one at a time, host
first, each with what it has not heard yet; their messages (`room_id` set) stay out of chats.

202.description: Queued: one message per agent, or in a room the next speaker's (none while an agent still speaks)

get.summary:
Whether the daemon host's own `claude` CLI is installed and signed in, for Claude Code
providers. Only the login state is returned, never the account.
Plugins installed in the host's Claude Code (`claude plugin list`).
Hooks and plugins for agents on Claude Code. Only the operator sets them; agents cannot.

put.summary:
Replaces the hooks and plugins for agents on Claude Code, from their next turn on. Hooks
run on this computer, outside the sandboxes; the user's own Claude Code settings stay out.

get.summary: The CLI packages in every agent's sandbox.

put.summary:
Replaces the CLI packages and builds their image in the background. New sandboxes start
from it; existing ones switch when they next wake, keeping their home directory.

400.description: Not a Debian package name, or too many

501.description: The sandbox backend cannot build images

get.summary: Configured connectors, by name.

post.summary:
Adds a connector and checks it (see `POST /v1/connectors/{id}/check`). Agents get its tools
once they are assigned it.

delete.summary:
Deletes a connector, its token and its assignments; OAuth tokens are
revoked at the server when it offers that.

patch.summary: Edits a connector. Open sessions with it are closed and it is checked again.

post.summary:
Connects to the connector with its current token or sign-in, lists its tools and keeps the
outcome as the connector's `check`. Never starts a sign-in. Runs on its own after adding or
changing a connector and after a sign-in.

Starts an OAuth sign-in for a connector without a token and returns the page to sign in on;
the browser comes back to `/v1/oauth/callback`.

400.description: Uses a token, or the server offers no usable OAuth

delete.summary:
Signs a connector out: asks the server to revoke its tokens (RFC 7009)
when it offers that, then forgets them here either way and checks it again.

get.summary:
Agent-to-agent conversations (one per pair of agents), most recent first; call room turns
are left out.

Read-only thread between two agents: messages in both directions, oldest
first (last 200), without call room turns. The order of `a` and `b` does not matter.
The dashboards, in order, each with its newest shared version.

put.summary: Replaces the dashboards: adding, renaming, reordering and removing all send the whole list.

400.description: Too many, a bad label or path, or an unknown agent

get.summary: Versions, setup and counts for a bug report.
The latest daemon log lines, kept in memory since the daemon started.

parameters.name: lines
parameters.description: How many of the latest lines (default 200, at most 2000).

get.summary: The Discord bridge.

put.summary:
Replaces the bridge's settings: on or off, the allowed Discord users, and which channel
talks to which agent. Changes apply within seconds.

400.description: A bad id, too many entries or an unknown agent

put.summary: Stores or removes the bot token, kept in the daemon's secret store.

get.summary: Group chats, oldest first.

post.summary: Creates a group chat. Its transcript is `GET /v1/rooms/{id}`.

400.description: Bad name or fewer than two agents

delete.summary: Deletes a group with its transcript; a member's running turn in it is cut off.

409.description: The group is in a call

patch.summary: Renames a group or replaces its members; a conversation going on continues with them.

400.description: Bad name or fewer than two agents

409.description: Members changed while the group is in a call

post.summary:
Calls the group: every member joins a voice call whose room is the group, so its lines land
there. The first member hosts. End it with `PUT /v1/call` and no agents.

409.description: Voice is switched off, or a call is running

post.summary:
Sends the operator's message to the group: a line that is due for every member. They answer
one at a time in join order, each with what it has not read yet, or pass; at most four agent
lines in a row, then the group waits for the operator. Their messages (`room_id` set) stay
out of chats. While the group is in a call, the message goes to the call.

202.description: Queued: the next speaker's message (none while a member still answers)

get.summary: Daemon identity and configuration summary.

How much of their 5-hour and weekly plan limits the host's Claude Code login and each Codex
provider signed in with `ChatGPT` have used, read from the CLIs (cached for a minute).
Every login for CLIs, with its agents.

put.summary:
Adds or replaces a login. Agents it reaches or leaves restart their computers (files kept);
so do all its agents when its hosts or variables change.

400.description: An invalid field or an unknown agent

delete.summary: Removes a login, its token and its CA; its agents restart their computers (files kept).

put.summary: Stores or removes the login's token. Kept in the daemon's secret store, never returned.

get.summary: Lists or searches the global memory all agents share.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Full-text search; empty lists the most recently updated entries.

post.summary: Creates or replaces a global memory.

get.summary: Where memories live.

put.summary:
Keeps memories in an Obsidian vault folder, or back in the built-in memory. Memories stored
so far are copied into the vault (notes with the same key are kept).

delete.summary: Deletes one global memory by key (URL-encoded).

get.summary:
Where the authorization server sends the browser back. Needs no operator
token: the single-use `state` from the sign-in it started authorizes it.

400.description: Unknown, used, expired or failed sign-in (HTML page)

get.summary: Where finished turns' traces go.

put.summary: Replaces the export settings. Each turn's trace then goes to the endpoint when the turn ends.
Stores or removes the auth header's value, kept in the daemon's secret store.

get.summary: The pinned replies and files, in order.

put.summary: Replaces the pin list: pinning, renaming, reordering and unpinning all send the whole list.

400.description: Too many pins, a bad label or an unknown agent

post.summary:
Serves a HTML block from the chat as a page, so its inline styles and scripts run under
the shared pages' policy (no network) instead of being blocked by the app's.

get.summary: The built-in model list for a provider kind, e.g. before the provider exists.
Configured model providers, by name.

post.summary: Adds a model provider.

delete.summary: Deletes a provider and its stored key. Fails while agents use it.

patch.summary:
Edits a provider. Agents using it restart their computers (disks kept)
when region, project or default model change.

get.summary: Whether a `codex` provider is signed in with `ChatGPT`.

post.summary:
Starts a `ChatGPT` sign-in for a `codex` provider on the daemon host: open
`verification_url`, enter `user_code`, poll the status. Agents never see the tokens.

502.description: codex failed on the daemon host

get.summary:
Models to offer for a provider: its own list fetched with the stored key (cached for a
few minutes), else a short built-in list.
Call rooms (calls with two or more agents), newest first; the last 200.
One call room or group: who is in it and what was said.

post.summary:
Joins the call agents started in room `id` without the operator: it becomes the voice call
and goes on in the same room. End it with `PUT /v1/call` and no agents.

409.description: Voice is switched off, a call is running, or that call is over

delete.summary: Deletes a routine and its run history.

patch.summary: Edits, enables or disables a routine.

409.description: Name already used by this agent

post.summary: Runs a routine now (does not move its schedule). Wakes the agent if needed.

get.summary: Run history, newest first (last 50).
The daemon-wide settings.
This daemon's version and, for a source build, the state of its update.

post.summary:
Updates a source build (a debug build from a ferrobot checkout on a clean `main`): pulls,
rebuilds the UI, daemon and desktop shell, then re-executes the daemon with the same
arguments. Runs in the background; poll `GET /v1/update`.

409.description: The checkout has changes or is not on main, or an update is running

get.summary:
Calls, tokens and estimated cost of the model calls agents made through
the proxy, in total and per group.

parameters.name: provider
parameters.description: Only this provider (id), or `default` for the daemon's own key.

parameters.name: daily
parameters.description: Also sum each group per day in the daemon's time zone (`days`).

get.summary:
Prices in USD per 1M tokens: the operator's overrides, then the shipped
table. Unlisted Ollama models cost 0.

put.summary:
Replaces the operator's price overrides (the whole list) and returns the
prices in effect.

get.summary: Voice settings and the speech providers.

put.summary:
Replaces the voice settings; with `api_key`, also stores or removes the
key of `provider`.

get.summary: The voices and speech models of the configured provider, fetched live.

409.description: Voice off, not set up or no key

put.summary: Stores or removes one speech provider's key without changing which provider is used.

post.summary:
Opens live transcription for dictation or a hands-free call
(`ElevenLabs` only; other providers transcribe after recording).

409.description: Voice off, not set up, no key, or not ElevenLabs

get.summary:
The same speech as a link, so an audio element can play it while it streams (the operator
token goes in `access_token`, as for other `GET` links).

parameters.name: agent_id
parameters.description: Speak with this agent's voice, if it has one.

409.description: Voice off, not set up, or no key or voice

post.summary:
Speaks `text` with the configured provider and voice. The audio
(usually `audio/mpeg`) streams while the provider makes it.

409.description: Voice off, not set up, or no key or voice

post.summary:
Transcribes a recording: the raw audio as the body, its type as
`Content-Type`.

requestBody.description: webm, ogg, mp4/m4a, mp3, wav or flac; at most 10 MiB

409.description: Voice off, not set up or no key

get.summary: Incoming and outgoing webhooks, oldest first.

post.summary: Creates an incoming webhook for an agent. Its URL is in this response only.

delete.summary: Deletes an incoming webhook; its URL stops working.

post.summary: Gives an incoming webhook a new secret; the old URL stops working at once.
Adds an outgoing webhook; the events it gets are posted to its URL in the background.

delete.summary: Deletes an outgoing webhook and its stored URL.

get.summary:
WebSocket of `UiEvent` text frames (`protocol/ui-events.schema.json`); client frames are
ignored. After a reconnect or a `lagged` gap, refetch over HTTP.

101.description: Switching protocols; then one `UiEvent` per text frame

Agent.description: A registered agent. Secrets (the runner token) are never part of this type.

name.description: Display and addressing name; unique, can be changed (rename).

sandbox_name.description:
Stable name of the agent's sandbox resources (container, disk). Set
at creation and kept on rename.

description.description: One-line description shown in agent lists.

instructions.description: Operator-provided role handed to the model as system instructions.

avatar_rev.description: Changes whenever the avatar changes; positive while an avatar exists.

oneOf.description: Chosen character avatar look; `null` means derived from the id.

Agent that created this one (with operator approval); `null` means
the operator created it.

model.description: Model id; `null` uses the provider's default model.

backend.description: Backend kind that owns the sandbox, e.g. `docker`.

sandbox_id.description: Backend-specific sandbox identifier (container id, sprite name, ...).

session_id.description: Last model session id reported by the runner, used for resume.

pinned.description: Pinned to the top of the operator's agent list.

tools.description: Tool groups the agent may use; its connectors are its assignment.

tags.description: The operator's labels for the agent, in order.

AgentContext.description: How full an agent's context is, read from its newest model call.

tracked.description:
Whether the daemon knows the agent's context size: from the model proxy, or on Claude
Code from the token counts its own stream reports. `true` today; kept for older clients.

tokens.description:
Input plus cache read and write tokens of the newest call since the last new chat;
`null` before there is one.

window.description: Context window of `model` in tokens; `null` when not known.

model.description: The model of that call, else the agent's configured model.

compact.description: Whether `POST /v1/agents/{id}/compact` works for this agent (Claude Code agents).

AgentId.description: Stable, opaque identifier of an agent.

AgentName.description:
Unique agent handle like `build-bot`: 1-32 chars of `a-z0-9-`, starting with a letter and
not ending with `-`, so it stays DNS-safe in sandbox resource names.

AgentStatus.description: Lifecycle state of an agent's sandbox as tracked by the daemon.

connected.description: Whether the agent's runner is connected right now.

unread.description: Finished turns since the operator last marked the chat as read.

avatar_url.description: Relative URL of the avatar image, if one was uploaded.

oneOf.description: Set while the agent's model credential is missing or rejected; its turns wait.

Set while the agent's model can't use tools and the operator has not turned them off;
its turns wait.

waiting.description: Question cards waiting for the operator's answer.

oneOf.description: The agent's newest reply, cut to a preview.

answers.description: One answer per question of the card.

oneOf.description: An agent wants to create another agent (`create_agent` tool).

name.description: Requested name of the new agent.

oneOf.description:
An agent wants to add a connector (`add_connector` tool). Approving creates it and gives
it to the agent; a token, if it takes one, goes in under Settings, never on a card.

command.description: A local server's program and arguments (it runs on the daemon's computer).

requester.description: The agent that asked: it gets the connector and a message with the outcome.

oneOf.description:
An agent wants a routine of its own (`create_routine` tool): `prompt` reaches it on
`schedule` (cron, the daemon's time zone).

An agent wants to give an agent it created more tools (`set_agent_tools` tool). The new
sets replace the target's; `null` leaves that set as it is.

The agent's model refused a request with tools (raised by the daemon). Approving turns
off its tool groups and connectors so its waiting messages run as plain chat.

The tool-call classifier flagged a call as risky and Auto mode is off: the call waits
for the operator.

detail.description: The command or the call's arguments, shortened.

reason.description: What made the call risky, e.g. "pushes code".

critical.description:
A very risky step (money, deleting in a connected service, force-pushing,
publishing): Auto mode still asks, and only the app answers it.

Approval.description:
What an approval card asks the operator to allow; the decision goes to the waiting tool
call, not to the agent's mailbox.

AvatarCharacter.description:
A chosen character avatar look; without one, clients derive a look from the agent id.
An uploaded avatar image wins over both.

channel_id.description: The Discord channel id (a number, as text).

body.description:
1..19316 bytes after trimming, counting `@name` mentions as their
stored `<@agent-id>` tokens (the rest of a message is left for what
the others said).

agents.description: Agents in the operator's voice call (at most 4); empty: no call.

room_id.description: The call's room, once a second agent joined; ignored when sent.

ChannelStatus.description: How a bridged channel is doing.

checked_at.description: When the daemon last read the channel.

error.description: Why the last read or reply failed; `null` when it worked.

note.description: Why the latest new messages were left out (a user not in the list, an empty message).

CharacterBody.description: Body shape of the generated character avatar.

CharacterEyes.description: Eye style of the generated character avatar.

value.description: Stable value reported in the answer; defaults to the label.

ClaudeCodeSettings.description:
Hooks and plugins for agents on Claude Code. Only the operator sets them; the user's own
Claude Code settings stay out.

plugins.description: Installed plugins (`name@marketplace`) turned on for agents.

subagents.description:
Claude Code's own subagents (its `Task` tool). They get the same ferrobot tools and
still reach the sandbox only through MCP; they use more of the seat.

ClaudeCodeStatus.description: Whether the host's `claude` is installed and signed in; never its account details.

auth_method.description: How it is signed in, e.g. `claude.ai`.

ClisView.description: The CLI packages and where their image build stands.

packages.description: Debian packages added to the base image, sorted.

error.description: Why the last build failed; null otherwise.

supported.description: Whether the sandbox backend can build images (Docker only).

Connector.description: A remote MCP server whose tools assigned agents can use.

name.description:
1-16 chars, `a-z0-9-`, starts with a letter. Prefixes its tools
(`<name>__<tool>`).

url.description: Streamable HTTP endpoint of a remote MCP server; empty for a local one.

command.description:
A local MCP server: its program and arguments, started on the daemon's computer without
a shell (e.g. `["npx", "-y", "@scope/server"]`). `None`: a remote server at `url`.

token_env.description:
The environment variable a local server gets the connector's Vault token in, e.g.
`GITHUB_TOKEN`.

tools.description: The server's tools agents may use, by the server's own names; `None`: all of them.

ConnectorAuth.description: How a connector an agent proposes signs in (`add_connector` tool).

ConnectorCheck.description: The outcome of connecting to a connector as the daemon and listing its tools.

tools.description: Tools agents can use (with `ok`), within the connector's `tools`.

names.description: Every tool the server offers, by its own name (with `ok`), to choose `tools` from.

error.description: Why it failed (with `failed`), in ferrobot's words, never the server's.

has_token.description: Whether a token is stored. The token itself is never returned.

signed_in.description: Whether the connector is signed in with OAuth.

client_id.description:
Client id of the operator's own OAuth app, if set (else dynamic
client registration is used).

has_client_secret.description: Whether that app's client secret is stored. Never returned.

scopes.description: Scopes asked for at sign-in; empty: the server's choice.

issuer.description: The authorization server the own OAuth app belongs to.

redirect_uri.description: Register this redirect URI with the provider for an own OAuth app.

oneOf.description:
The last connection check; `null` until one ran since the daemon
started or the connector changed.

a.description: The two agents, ordered by id.

name.description:
1-32 chars, `a-z0-9-`, starts with a letter. Unique; can be changed later
with `PATCH` (other agents address it by id, or by its current name).

description.description: One line shown in agent lists (max 280 bytes).

instructions.description: System instructions (role) for the agent's model.

oneOf.description: Character avatar look; omitted or `null`: derived from the id.

model.description: Model id; omitted: the provider's default model.

tools.description:
Tool groups the agent may use; omitted: all. Connectors are assigned with
`PUT /v1/agents/{id}/connectors`.

tags.description: Labels for the operator: at most 5, each 1-20 characters after trimming, no duplicates.

name.description: 1-16 chars, `a-z0-9-`, starts with a letter; prefixes the tools.

url.description: Streamable HTTP endpoint of a remote MCP server; leave it out for a local one.

command.description:
A local MCP server: its program and arguments, started on this computer without a shell
(e.g. `["npx", "-y", "@scope/server"]`).

token_env.description: The environment variable a local server gets `token` in, e.g. `GITHUB_TOKEN`.

token.description:
Sent as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Kept in the daemon's secret store;
never returned.

client_id.description:
Client id of your own OAuth app, for servers without dynamic client
registration (e.g. Google). Register `redirect_uri` with it.

client_secret.description: That app's client secret. Kept in the daemon's secret store; never returned.

scopes.description: Scopes to ask for at sign-in (space-separated entries are split).

issuer.description:
The authorization server the app belongs to (e.g. `https://accounts.google.com`);
needed with `client_id`. Sign-ins through any other server are refused.

members.description: At least two agents; the first hosts the group's calls.

api_key.description: Kept in the daemon's secret store; never returned.

prompt.description: Message the agent receives on every run.

timezone.description: IANA time zone; defaults to the daemon's (see `/v1/health`).

CredentialError.description:
A model credential problem found by the model proxy. The agent's messages wait until the
operator changes its provider or model, stores a key or retries. Kept in memory: after a
restart the next model call finds it again.

reason.description: What is wrong and where to fix it; never contains the key.

CredentialProblem.description: What is wrong with an agent's model credential.

Dashboard.description: A dashboard: a shared HTML file, by its agent and path.

path.description: The file's path in the agent's computer, e.g. `/home/agent/finance.html`.

file.description:
Read only (ignored when saving): the newest shared version's `file` event; `null`
until one is shared.

updated_at.description: Read only (ignored when saving): when that version was shared.

DeviceCode.description: A device code the operator enters at `verification_url`.

Diagnostics.description: What a bug report needs about this daemon. Never holds a key or token.

data_dir.description: Directory with the database and the API token file.

storage.description: Where snapshot archives go: `local`, or the scheme of `--storage-url` (`s3`, ...).

sandbox_ready.description: Whether the sandbox backend can start agents now (Docker: the engine answers).

sandbox_error.description: Why the backend is not ready; null when ready.

runner_image.description: Image sandboxes start from by default; null: the backend has no images.

runner_image_id.description: That image's id; null when the engine does not have it or did not answer.

anthropic_key.description: Whether the daemon has its own `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` for agents without a provider.

lines.description: Oldest first, without colour codes; what looks like a credential reads `[REDACTED]`.

DiscordSettings.description: The bridge's settings; the bot token is in the secret store.

users.description: Discord user ids whose messages reach agents; everyone else is ignored.

bridges.description: Each channel talks to one agent.

has_token.description: A bot token is in the secret store; it is never returned.

DiscordView.description: The bridge's settings, whether a bot token is stored, and how each channel is doing.

ErrorBody.description: JSON body of every non-2xx UI API response.

ExecOutput.description: Exit code and captured output of a command.

truncated.description: True if output was cut at [`MAX_EXEC_OUTPUT`].

error.description: Why it failed; `null` when it went through.

FormerAgent.description: A deleted agent's last name, so mentions of it can still be read.

GeneralSettings.description: Daemon-wide settings. Omitted fields take their defaults.

auto_mode.description: Agents create agents without an approval card. The agent limit still applies.

agent_names.description:
How agents name the agents they create, in the operator's words (e.g. "Greek gods");
`null`: short role names. 1-300 characters.

body.description:
1..19316 bytes after trimming, counting `@name` mentions as their stored `<@agent-id>`
tokens.

model_proxy.description:
Whether agents make real model calls through the proxy (any driver
but `mock`); each still needs a provider or `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`.

idle_timeout_s.description: Seconds idle before a sandbox is stopped (cold sleep); null: never.

timezone.description: Default time zone for new routines.

sandbox_ready.description: Whether the sandbox backend can start agents now (Docker: the engine answers).

sandbox_error.description: Why the backend is not ready, for the operator; null when ready.

anthropic_key.description: Whether the daemon has its own `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` for agents without a provider.

Hook.description: A shell command Claude Code runs on this computer, outside the sandboxes, when `event` fires.

matcher.description:
The tools it runs for, as Claude Code matches them (e.g. `mcp__ferrobot__bash`);
tool events only. `null`: every tool.

HookEvent.description: When a hook runs. Only events that fire in a `claude -p` turn.

IncomingWebhook.description: An incoming webhook. Its secret is shown once; only its hash is stored.

agent_id.description: The agent its requests go to as messages.

url.description: `<daemon>/hooks/{id}/{secret}`; from the internet, through a tunnel to `/hooks/` only.

IncomingWebhookCreated.description: An incoming webhook with its URL. The URL holds the secret and is shown only this once.

InstalledPlugin.description: A plugin installed in the host's Claude Code.

turn_id.description: The interrupted turn, or null if the agent was idle.

agents.description: With `chain`: every agent whose work was stopped, this one first.

dropped.description: With `chain`: how many queued agent messages were dropped.

LastReply.description: The start of an agent's newest reply.

resets.description:
When the window starts over: Claude Code's own words (e.g. `Nov 26 at 6:59am
(Europe/Berlin)`), or an RFC 3339 time for Codex.

LiveMode.description: How live speech is cut into messages.

sample_rate.description:
Sample rate of the 16-bit mono PCM the app sends: 8000, 16000,
22050, 24000, 44100 or 48000.

url.description:
The provider's WebSocket with a single-use token (valid 15 minutes,
one session of at most 10 minutes); the real key never leaves the daemon.

Login.description: A login for CLIs: which hosts get the real token and where the CLIs look for it.

id.description: 1-32 chars of `a-z0-9-`, starting with a letter, e.g. `example`.

hosts.description: API hosts whose requests get the real token, exact public names like `api.example.com`.

env.description: Environment variables the CLIs read their token from; they get a stand-in.

programs.description: Program names that use this login, e.g. `example`; see `confirm`.

confirm.description:
Ask before every command that runs one of `programs` or names one of `env` or `hosts`,
unless Auto mode is on.

agents.description: The agents whose CLIs use this login.

hosts.description: API hosts whose requests get the real token, e.g. `api.example.com`.

env.description: Environment variables the CLIs read their token from, e.g. `EXAMPLE_API_KEY`.

programs.description: Program names that use the login, e.g. `example`.

confirm.description: Ask before every command that uses the login, unless Auto mode is on.

agents.description: The agents whose CLIs use the login.

oneOf.description: Not signed in.
Waiting for the operator to confirm the code in the browser.

LoginStatus.description: Sign-in progress per provider (in memory; a restart forgets pending ones).

token.description: The service's token, e.g. a fine-grained GitHub token; `null` removes it.

has_token.description: Whether a token is stored. The token itself is never returned.

MailMessage.description: One message in an agent's mailbox.

body.description:
Text; mentions of agents are stored as `<@agent-id>` tokens (see
`ferrobot_core::mention`), so render them with the current names.

priority.description:
`true`: wakes the recipient and goes first; `false`: waits for its next turn
without waking it; `null` (default): queues and wakes.

room_id.description: The call room whose turn this message carries; such messages stay out of the agent's chat.

MailStatus.description:
Delivery state: `pending`, `in_flight`, `delivered`; back to `pending` when a runner
disconnects mid-turn, `failed` after too many attempts.

MemoryEntry.description: One long-term memory, an agent's own or global.

author.description: Global memory only: the agent that wrote it; absent = the operator.

MemoryVaultView.description: Where memories live: an Obsidian vault folder, or the built-in memory.

path.description:
The vault folder; memories are Markdown notes under its `ferrobot/` folder. `null`: the
built-in memory.

obsidian.description: The folder is an Obsidian vault (it has `.obsidian`).

copied.description: After a change: how many stored memories were copied into the vault.

id.description: The id an agent or provider uses as its `model`.

name.description: Display name, when the provider gives one.

ModelList.description: Models to offer for a provider. Any other id can still be typed.

ModelOption.description: A text-to-speech model of the account.

ModelSource.description: Where a model list comes from.

name.description: 1-64 characters; agents see it as the sender, `webhook:<name>`.

url.description: An http or https URL, e.g. a Discord or Slack webhook; kept in the secret store.

agents.description: Only these agents' events; empty or omitted: every agent's.

authorization_url.description: Open this in a browser on the daemon's computer to sign in.

value.description: The auth header's value, e.g. `Bearer …` or `Basic …`; `null` removes it.

OtelSettings.description: Where finished turns' traces go. The auth header's value is in the secret store.

header.description: The auth header's name, e.g. `Authorization`; `null`: none.

project.description: Sent as the `openinference.project.name` resource attribute (Phoenix's project).

content.description: Also send tool inputs and the turn's reply; off: only names, times, tokens and errors.

has_secret.description: The auth header's value is in the secret store; it is never returned.

OtelView.description: The export settings, whether the header's value is stored, and how the last export went.

OutgoingWebhook.description: An outgoing webhook. Its URL is in the secret store and never returned.

agents.description: Only these agents' events; empty: every agent's.

oneOf.description: `null`: nothing sent since the daemon started.

OutgoingWebhookView.description: An outgoing webhook and how its last delivery went.

Pin.description: A pinned reply or shared file, in the pin list's order.

agent_id.description: The agent whose chat holds it.

event.description: The reply's `assistant_text` event, or the file's `file` event.

label.description: Shown in the pin list; 1-120 characters.

body.description:
1..32768 bytes after trimming. `@name` mentions of existing agents are
stored as `<@agent-id>` tokens, and the limit counts them as stored.

now.description:
Send now: if the agent is in a turn that cannot take the message (its runner does not
steer), that turn stops so the message goes next. Otherwise it waits for the turn to end.

Presence.description: What an agent is doing right now, for status badges.

url.description:
The block as a sandboxed page (relative to the daemon), a signed link that works for
30 minutes.

html.description: The block's HTML, at most 512 KiB.

cache_read.description: `null`: unknown; calls with cache reads then cost an unknown amount.

cache_write.description: `null`: unknown; calls with cache writes then cost an unknown amount.

model.description: API model id, as agents send it.

checked.description: When the price was read off the source, or set by the operator (`YYYY-MM-DD`).

source.description: The provider's pricing page; `null` for the operator's own price.

PriceEntry.description: One model's price and where it comes from.

Provider.description:
A configured model provider. Its credential lives in the daemon's secret
store, never here.

base_url.description: Upstream override; `null` uses the kind's default.

default_model.description: Model for agents that do not pick one.

ProviderKind.description:
The API family of a provider. Decides the runner driver, the upstream
URL and how the daemon's model proxy adds the credential.

error.description: Why the limits could not be read.

has_key.description: Whether an API key is stored. The key itself is never returned.

values.description: Selected choice values (`single`: at most one).

message_id.description:
The user message that carried the answer to the agent; `null` for
approval cards (the decision goes to the waiting tool call).

timed_out.description: No answer came in time: the daemon declined the approval card.

oneOf.description: Set on approval cards raised by the daemon (e.g. for `create_agent`).

turn_id.description: The turn that raised the card (its trace shows the wait); `null` outside a turn.

emoji.description: One emoji, e.g. 👍. A new reaction replaces your earlier one on that message.

a group chat, kept until deleted.

members.description: Every agent that took part (a group: its members), in the order they joined.

ended_at.description: When the call ended; `null` while it runs, and always for a group.

body.description: The words; mentions are `<@agent-id>` tokens. With `invited`, the topic that agent got.

invited.description: The agent this line brought into the call; `null` for words said.

oneOf.description: The member whose turn it is (writing or speaking), if any; `room_floor` events follow it.

joinable.description: A call among agents the operator can join (`POST /v1/rooms/{id}/call`).

RoomTranscript.description: A room with what was said in it.

Routine.description: A prompt an agent receives on a cron schedule.

prompt.description: Message sent to the agent on every run.

next_run_at.description: Next scheduled run; null while disabled.

schedule_text.description: English description of the schedule, e.g. "At 09:00 on Monday through Friday".

backend.description: Backend kind, e.g. `docker`; null before provisioning.

snapshots_supported.description: Whether the backend can snapshot and restore.

The agent's model refused a request with tools. The agent's messages wait until the operator

stream (`model_call` events); `false` for Claude Code turns from before those.

disk, memory and history.

instructions.description: New system instructions; a connected runner applies them from its next turn.

oneOf.description: New character avatar look; `null` goes back to the one derived from the id.

model.description: New model id; `null` goes back to the provider's default model.

pinned.description: Pin to the top of the agent list (or unpin).

tools.description:

packages.description: Debian package names, at most 32; empty: the plain base image.

tools.description: The server's tools agents may use, by its own names; `null`: all of them.

token.description: New token; `null` removes the stored one.

client_id.description:
Own OAuth app; `null` goes back to dynamic client registration.
Changing the app signs the connector out.

client_secret.description:
`null` removes the stored client secret. Changing the URL, client id
or issuer without sending a new secret removes it too.

issuer.description: Issuer of the own OAuth app.

members.description: At least two agents; omitted keeps them. Those who stay keep their place.

UpdateInfo.description: This daemon's version and self-update status.

source_build.description:
A debug build from a ferrobot checkout, which `POST /v1/update` can pull, rebuild and
restart. Release builds update through the desktop app.

commit.description: The checkout's commit when this daemon started (source builds).

step.description: The command that is running or failed.

api_key.description: New API key; `null` removes the stored one.

UpdateRoutine.description: Partial update; omitted fields stay unchanged.

api_key.description:

daemon's secret store; never returned.

path.description: Where the file is, relative to the agent's workspace, e.g. `uploads/photo.png`.

key.description:

label.description: Date, agent name, provider name or model id.

days.description: Sums per day, oldest first, only days with calls; only with `daily=true`.

IANA time zone of the `days` dates (the daemon's `--timezone`); only

Sums for a time range or group. Costs are what `OpenRouter` reported it charged, else

input_tokens.description: Input tokens without cache reads and writes.

cost_usd.description:
USD: `OpenRouter`'s reported charge where given, else estimated from prices; `null` when
no call here could be priced.

unknown_cost_calls.description: Calls with tokens but no known price (not in `cost_usd`).

not_tracked_calls.description: Successful calls whose API reported no tokens.

voices.description: The account's voices (`ElevenLabs`); empty for other providers.

tts_models.description: Text-to-speech models of the account (`ElevenLabs`); empty otherwise.

api_key.description: The new key; `null` removes it. Kept in the daemon's secret store; never returned.

languages.description: Languages the voice is verified for (codes), else its `language` label.

oneOf.description: Who speaks and listens; `null`: voice is not set up.

Voice id (`ElevenLabs`) or name (`OpenRouter`); `null`: the

Voices by agent id, so agents in a call sound different; the others
